title: Judge a visual agent's candidate actions by drawing them on the screenshot
tldr: Sample several actions from a frozen visual policy, draw each on its own screenshot copy, score them with a probability-returning judge, and override greedy only on a clear lead; no training needed.

sources.title: Bel: Step-Level Policy Improvement of Visual Agents Without Training

title: Which links a web agent clicks leaks its private context past content-level defenses
tldr: A stateful attacker placing one link on a visited page reconstructs a web agent's private query (F1 0.89) and profile (F1 0.80) from which links it clicks; content filters do not help.

sources.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Stateful Privacy Sniffing of LLM Agents via Behavioral Covert Channels in Web Interactions

title: Weights fine-tuned under one agent harness collapse under another
tldr: Weights fine-tuned on trajectories from their own evolved harness score 19.8% under that harness but 2.6% under a reference harness, so harness revisions reopen the training decision.

sources.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?

title: Agent-chosen belief-state folds turn long research runs into rubric-rewarded segments
tldr: Letting a research agent rewrite its context into a four-field belief state at self-chosen checkpoints, then rewarding each resulting segment with an outcome-blind rubric plus validity gate, reaches 0.151 Brier on ForecastBench.

sources.title: Belief-State Management Meets Rubric Rewards for Agentic Forecasting

title: Most broken agentic-benchmark graders reject valid work rather than reward shortcuts
tldr: A 749-task audit across eight benchmarks finds only 29.3% of multi-step tasks have prompt, environment and grader that agree, and 71.7% of defects wrongly reject valid work rather than reward shortcuts.

title: What users later do with an agent's output is a refreshable, hard-to-game verifier
tldr: Labeling agent output as useful when the person receiving it later acts on it gives a refreshable verifier whose precision rankings match a gold set (rho 0.69) and resist gaming.

sources.title: CodeReviewBench: An Automated Benchmark for Evaluating the Software Factory

title: Grade the diff in a fresh container: confirmed bypasses fall from 14.7% to 2.7%
tldr: Extract only the committed patch or declared outputs, grade in a fresh network-disabled container, blind-solve tasks before freezing tests, and require broken submissions the grader rejects; bypasses fall from 14.7% to 2.7%.

title: Asking a yes/no decision model per step gives label-free process rewards for agent RL
tldr: Per step of every rollout, ask a probability-returning decision model whether the step made progress, standardise scores within the task's rollout group, and add them to GRPO advantages; ALFWorld success rises from 66.3% to 90.0%.

sources.title: Decision Models Are General-Purpose Process Reward Models

title: One token the student cannot produce can derail on-policy distillation
tldr: In sampled-token on-policy distillation, a teacher-preferred token the student almost never samples (like a mismatched EOS) is never learned yet still distorts updates, lengthening and looping outputs while overlap stays high.

sources.title: When Students Fail to Learn from Teachers: Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation

title: Route low-coverage states to forward KL during on-policy distillation
tldr: Applying top-16 forward KL only at states where the student's mass on the teacher's top-p tokens is low, or teacher mass is underestimated, beats sampled-token on-policy distillation and blanket forward KL.

sources.title: When Students Fail to Learn from Teachers: Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation
